# VisualTalk

> VisualTalk is a lightweight, open-source video-conferencing client for
> self-hosted LiveKit servers: bring your own server, keep recordings on your
> device, chat and share files inside the meeting. No accounts, no analytics,
> and no conferencing infrastructure operated by the publisher. A separate
> Pro edition (in app-store review) adds end-to-end encrypted chat and files
> plus organizer RTMP streaming.

visualtalk.app is a small static site. Every page is semantic HTML5 carrying
schema.org JSON-LD; all indexable pages are listed in /sitemap.xml and
described below. Installer integrity data is published as a plain-text
SHA-256 manifest at /downloads/SHA256SUMS.txt.

## Product

- [Home](https://visualtalk.app/): what VisualTalk is, and why it is light on battery and download size.
- [VisualTalk Pro](https://visualtalk.app/pro/): the coming-soon separate app — E2EE chat/files (ECDH P-256 key agreement, per-message AES-256-GCM), key pinning with loud failure, organizer RTMP streaming, commercial licensing. Explicitly NOT E2EE media.
- [Why Tauri](https://visualtalk.app/why-tauri/): the Rust + Tauri design (no bundled browser engine, no background services, wake lock only during calls), with an explicit "what we are not claiming" section.

## Documentation

- [How to use VisualTalk](https://visualtalk.app/how-to/): plain-words setup — get the app, pick a server (LiveKit Cloud or the free Docker bundle), paste three values, first meeting, recording, troubleshooting. Also published as schema.org HowTo.
- [Comment utiliser VisualTalk](https://visualtalk.app/how-to/fr/): the same guide in French (hreflang alternate of the English page).

## Downloads

- [Downloads](https://visualtalk.app/downloads/): current Community Edition installers (macOS dmg, Windows exe/msi, Linux deb/rpm/AppImage, self-hosted server zip) with sizes, signing status and per-file SHA-256.
- [SHA-256 checksums](https://visualtalk.app/downloads/SHA256SUMS.txt): machine-readable manifest, `shasum -a 256 -c` compatible.

## Legal

- [Privacy policy](https://visualtalk.app/privacy): no accounts, no analytics; what stays on the device and what a server operator can see.

## Notes for automated agents

- `/j/?room=<code>` is a meeting-handoff utility (robots-noindex): it displays a room code with a copy button and carries no credentials. Do not crawl its query space.
- Invite links use the custom scheme `visualtalk://join?room=…&url=…&token=…` (or `…&issuer=…&invite=…` in issuer mode). They are bearer credentials: never log, cache or re-publish them.
- Android App Links verification file: `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` (package `com.katebg.visualtalk`).
- Source repository: https://github.com/pointer/visualtalk — architecture decisions live in `docs/decisions/` (ADR format).
- Support contact: kghemari@yahoo.com
